name: portavoce
description: Sends a push and an email when a Claude Code usage limit resets. Token-free: no model calls.

ntfy_topic.title: ntfy topic
ntfy_topic.description: Optional. Leave empty to push to a private topic Portavoce makes (claude-portavoce-<random>); run /portavoce topic to see it and subscribe the phone app. Set a name here to use your own.

notify_email.title: Notification email
notify_email.description: Optional. Where ntfy sends the limit-restored email; leave empty to push to the phone only.

ntfy_token.title: ntfy access token
ntfy_token.description: Optional. Needed only for the email; ntfy.sh refuses emails from anonymous requests.

show_parrot.title: Show the parrot emoji
show_parrot.description: On by default. Includes 🦜 at the start of ntfy push and email titles; turn off for plain titles.

delay_seconds.title: Post-reset delay
delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait after the reset time before notifying, 0 to 86400 (default: 60).
